text:
Maya: short heads-up — saw two intake failures: token-count mismatch caused by inconsistent newline handling across tokenizers. quick repro below.

Maya: repro:
```
model: ember-chat-7b
input: "foo
bar"
expected tokens: [foo, 
, bar]
observed tokens: [foo, bar]
expected token_count 38 vs observed 36
```

Maya: proposal: add a versioned normalization step in intake (normalizer v1) that emits a normalized artifact used for fast automated benches, and keep raw artifact for async validation.

Alex: +1 but keep both. normalized for quick admission; raw run async and required within 24h. if raw differs by >4% tokens or >8% p50 latency, open triage.

Jun: implementation notes: intake writes model-raw.tgz and model-normalized-v1.tgz. bencher CLI gets `--artifact raw|normalized`. metrics are stored as `token_count.normalized.v1` and `token_count.raw`.

Nina: add a lint to warn when models register custom tokenizer hooks so normalization doesn't hide behavior. lint name: `tokenizer.custom_hooks_present` (warn).

bench-bot: normalized bench complete for ember-chat-7b — token_count.normalized.v1=38, latency.p50.normalized.v1=29ms. raw bench queued job=9932.

Maya: i'll draft a short RFC blurb (schema, gating thresholds, triage flow). Jun, can you add the artifact selector to bencher? ETA 4 days.

Jun: yup, will do.

bench-bot: raw bench complete — token_count.raw=39 (delta +2.6%), latency.p50.raw=31ms (delta +6.9%). within thresholds, no ticket opened.
